boundary: The cocycle is the frame-torsor descent class. The rank-defect histogram is a useful norm on its action but is not promoted to an additive cohomology class.

correction.rank_defect: delta(g)=dim(V+gV)-7 is a class-stratified obstruction norm, not an additive group 1-cocycle

genuine_obstruction_class.object: nonabelian Cech 1-cocycle of the ordered-frame D8 torsor

minimal_marking.data: one vertex plus one adjacent direction
minimal_marking.proof: The D8 action on the eight directed edges is regular. Any marking that kills the complete D8 stabilizer must have orbit size |D8|=8, so three bits are necessary and sufficient.

theorem: The descent obstruction has two logically distinct layers. The numerical rank defect delta is not a group cocycle. The genuine cohomological datum is the nonabelian Cech transition cocycle t_ij=g_i^{-1}g_j of the regular D8 frame torsor. Because the seven-dimensional relation space has trivial D8 stabilizer, descent is equivalent to trivializing that torsor. A directed boundary edge does so with exactly eight states; its D8 action is regular. Thus one vertex plus one adjacent direction is the minimal marking, strictly smaller than a full ordered four-tuple, and three bits are necessary and sufficient.
